compare.e: L.comparare, 源自 compar like or equal to another; com- + par equal: 参见 法语 comparer. 见 Pair, Peer an equal, and 参见 Compeer.

comparison.e: 法语 comparaison, 拉丁语 comparatio. 见 1st Compare.

compartment.e: 法语 compartiment, 古法语 compartir to divide. 见 Compart.

compass.e: 法语 compas, 源自 后期拉丁语 compassus circle, prop., a stepping together; com- + passus pace, step. 见 Pace, Pass.

compassion.e: 法语, 源自 拉丁语 compassio, 源自 compati to have compassion; com- + pati to bear, suffer. 见 Patient.
r: the act, process, or result of
k: 委任状，任官令，所委职责

compatible.e: 法语, 源自 LL.compatibilis, 源自 拉丁语 compati. 见 Compassion.

k: 不相容的，不能并存的，矛盾的

compatriot.e: 法语 compatriote, 后期拉丁语 compatriotus; com- + patriota a native. 见 Patriot, and 参见 Copatriot.

compel.e: 拉丁语 compellere, compulsum, to drive together, to compel, urge; com- + pellere to drive: 参见 古法语 compellir. 见 Pulse.

compendium.e: 拉丁语 compendium that which is weighed, saved, or shortened, a short way, 源自 compendere to weigh; com- + pendere to weigh. 见 Pension, and 参见 Compend.

compensate.e: 拉丁语 compensatus, 过去分词 of compensare, prop., to weigh several things with one another, to balance with one another, verb intens. 源自 compendere. 见 Compendium.

compensation.e: 拉丁语 compensatio a weighing, a balancing of accounts.

k: 评论员，实况广播员，注释者

compete.e: 拉丁语 completere, competitum; com- + petere to seek. 见 Petition.

competence.e: 参见 法语 compétence, from 拉丁语 competentia agreement.

compilation.e: 拉丁语 compilatio: 参见 法语 compilation.

compile.e: 法语 compiler, fr.拉丁语 compilare to plunder, pillage; com- + pilare to plunder. 见 Pill, v. t., Pillage.

compiler.e: 中古英语 compiluor; 参见 古法语 compileor, 源自 拉丁语 compilator.

complacence.e: 后期拉丁语 complacentia: 参见 法语 complaisance. 见 Complacent, and 参见 Complaisance.

complain.e: 法语 complaindre, 后期拉丁语 complangere; com- + 拉丁语 plangere to strike, beat, to beat the breast or head as a sign of grief, to lament. 见 Plaint.

complainant.e: 法语 complaignant, 现在分词 of complaindre.

complaisance.e: 法语 complaisance. 见 Complaisant, and 参见 Complacence.

complaisant.e: 法语 complaisant, 现在分词 of complaire to acquiesce as a favor, 源自 拉丁语 complacere. 见 Complacent.

complement.e: 拉丁语 complementun: 参见 法语 complément. 见 Complete, v. t., and 参见 Compliment.

comply.e: Perh. formed 源自 compliment, influenced by ply, pliant, which are of different origin: 参见 意大利语 complire to compliment, finish, suit. 见 Compliment, Complete.

component.e: 拉丁语 componens, 现在分词 of componere. 见 Compound, v. t.

composite.e: 拉丁语 compositus made up of parts, 过去分词 of componere. 见 Compound, v. t., and 参见 Compost.

composition.e: 法语 composition, 源自 拉丁语 compositio. 见 Composite.

压制性的，压迫的，沉重的

con.e: Abbrev. from 拉丁语 contra against.

concatenate.e: 拉丁语 concatenatus, 过去分词 of concatenare to concatenate. 见 Catenate.

concave.e: 拉丁语 concavus; con- + cavus hollow: 参见 法语 concave. 见 Cave a hollow.

concavity.e: 拉丁语 concavitas: 参见 法语 concavité. 见 Concave.

conceal.e: 古法语 conceler, 拉丁语 concelare; con- + celareto hide; 同源于 古英语 helan, 德语 hehlen, 英语 hele (to cover), helmet. 见 Hell, Helmet.

concede.e: 拉丁语 concedere, concessum; con- + cedere to go along, give way, yield: 参见 法语 concéder. 见 Cede.

conceit.e: Through French, 源自 拉丁语 conceptus a conceiving, conception, 源自 concipere to conceive: 参见 古法语 过去分词 nom. conciez conceived. 见 Conceive, and 参见 Concept, Deceit.

k: 不能想象的，想不到的，难信的

conceive.e: 古法语 conzoivre, concever, conceveir, 法语 concevoir, 源自 拉丁语 oncipere to take, to conceive; con- + capere to seize or take. 见 Capable, and 参见 Conception.

concentrate.e: Pref. con- + 拉丁语 centrum center. 参见 Concenter.
s: 用铆钉固定，敲进去，注目
集聚，集中，施行中央集权

concept.e: 拉丁语 conceptus (参见 neut. conceptum fetus), 过去分词 of concipere to conceive: 参见 法语 concept. 见 Conceit.

conception.e: 法语 conception, 拉丁语 conceptio, 源自 concipere to conceive. 见 Conceive.
s: 发明，创作能力，虚构的故事

concern.e: 法语 concerner, 后期拉丁语 concernere to regard, concern, 源自 拉丁语 concernere to mix or mingle together, as in a sieve for separating; con- + cernere to separate, sift, distinguish by the senses, and especially by the eyes, to perceive, see. 见 Certain.
s: 焦虑，忧虑，令人焦虑的事

k: 使改变信仰的人，炼钢炉，吹风转炉

concertina.e: From 意大利语 concerto a concert.

concerto.e: 意大利语 见 Concert, n.

concession.e: 拉丁语 concessio, 源自 concedere: 参见 法语 concession. 见 Concede.

concha.e: 后期拉丁语 (in sense 1), 源自 拉丁语 concha. 见 Conch.

conciliate.e: 拉丁语 conciliatus, 过去分词 of conciliare to draw or bring together, unite, from concilium council. 见 Council.

concise.e: 拉丁语 concisus cut off, short, 过去分词 of concidere to cut to pieces; con- + caedere to cut; 或许 同源于 scindere to cleave, and to 英语 shed, v. t.; 参见 法语 concis.
s: 神秘的，含义模糊的，隐藏的

conclave.e: 法语, 源自 拉丁语 conclave a room that may locked up; con- + clavis key. 见 Clavicle.

conclude.e: 拉丁语 concludere, conclusum; con- + claudere to shut. 见 Close, v. t.

conclusion.e: 法语, 源自 拉丁语 conclusio. 见 Conclude.
r: the act, process, or result of
k: 决定性的，确定性的，最后的

r: tending to, connected with, or performing
k: 非决定性的，无效果的，不得要领的

concoct.e: 拉丁语 concoctus, 过去分词 of concoquere to cook together, to digest, mature; con- + coquere to cook. 见 Cook.
